newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Eritrean President in Singapore for 3-day visit.
newsitem.headline: Eritrean President in Singapore for 3-day visit.

text.p: Eritrean President Isayas Afewerki arrived on Tuesday in Singapore for a three-day visit, officials said.

Afwerki, a former guerrilla leader who will be the first Eritrean president to visit Singapore, will hold talks with Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong on Wednesday, a Ministry of Foreign Affairs statement said.
Afwerki will visit the Port of Singapore Authority during his stay here.
The port expertise of Singapore may help Eritrea, which became independent from Ethiopia only in 1993, to rebuild the port of Massawa on the Red Sea.
Eritrea fought a bitter 30-year war against Ethiopia that ended in 1991. The country is trying hard to rebuild cities devastated by the long conflict with its southern neighbour.
